events.outcome: Current MTN prices are NGN3,500/1 year, NGN5,000/2 years and NGN7,500/3 years. Current prepaid terms also establish a visitor registration path without NIN for stays under 24 months, subject to valid visa and passport/travel documentation.

The August 2026 NCC Quality of Service Business Rules say a prepaid line may be deactivated after six months without a Revenue Generating Event and may lose the number after another six months. The same rules count parked numbers as an RGE, exclude bare recharge without follow-up qualifying activity, and require alternative-means notice at least 14 days before churn. MTN's current prepaid terms separately state a 365-day no-RGE disconnection rule, so the conflict is preserved instead of collapsed into one inactivity clock.
MTN currently supports eSIM, but first eSIM setup requires visiting an MTN store for device eligibility checks and a QR code. This does not establish remote China-first activation.

A 2026 independent Nairaland report says an MTN Nigeria number was reassigned despite the user reporting an active Keep My Number subscription and ongoing recharge. Treat this as a single-user continuity incident, not proof that KMN generally fails.

data.acquisitionSummary: MTN Nigeria prepaid supports the Keep My Number retention service. Regular SIM registration is Nigeria-side; NIN is normally required, while visitors staying under 24 months may register with a valid visa plus international passport/travel document. MTN also supports eSIM, but current eSIM setup requires an MTN-store eligibility check and QR-code provisioning. The reviewed official sources do not establish a universal starter-SIM acquisition price.

keep.action: Current MTN Keep My Number plans are NGN3,500/1 year, NGN5,000/2 years and NGN7,500/3 years. The 3-year option is the lowest annualized provider price. Fund sufficient airtime, dial *365# or use the matching SMS keyword, and deliberately select one-off or auto-renew; closing that selection without choosing means the purchase does not complete. NCC's 2026 rules separately treat parked numbers as a Revenue Generating Event.

data.chinaActivation: Initial SIM registration is a Nigeria-side process. Current MTN eSIM setup also requires visiting an MTN store for device eligibility and QR provisioning; remote China-first activation is not established.
data.kyc: A valid NIN is normally required. Visitors staying less than 24 months are expressly exempt from the NIN purchase requirement if they provide a valid visa and international passport/travel document. Registration must still be completed before full service.
data.payment: Keep My Number is paid from sufficient airtime balance. MTN currently offers online/card/bank-transfer airtime purchase channels, including Xtrabuy; reliable use of a foreign-issued card from abroad is not established.
data.roamingSms: MTN currently offers roaming to prepaid customers and lists China among TravelPass destinations with SMS capability. The reviewed provider material does not establish free incoming SMS or bank/app OTP delivery for this exact route, so overseas verification reliability remains unquantified.
data.tariffSummary: Keep My Number: NGN3,500/1y, NGN5,000/2y, NGN7,500/3y; 3y annualizes to NGN2,500/year. Current NCC rules preserve a separate six-month RGE/line-parking framework.
guideSteps: Register and activate the prepaid line in Nigeria with the applicable identity documents.
If using eSIM, complete the current MTN store eligibility and QR-provisioning process.
Fund sufficient airtime and subscribe to the chosen Keep My Number duration via *365# or the matching SMS keyword.
Choose one-off or auto-renew explicitly and verify the confirmation message.
Keep registration/contact details current and monitor the line; a 2026 independent reassignment incident means KMN should not be treated as an absolute continuity guarantee.
